cover_letter_text:
Hi Ryan,

I'd like to apply for the Civil Engineer role at Allen Price that I saw on SEEK. Your ad describes civil design for land development, including roads, landform and stormwater, alongside town planners and surveyors, the kind of team I'd like to grow with.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, carried out site inspections and reviewed drawings. As field engineer on subdivision finishing works I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared progress reports. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, designing road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D around existing services.

I'm based in Melton VIC and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I will relocate to Wollongong for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card, and I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
